focus: 用材料分流地形高程和生態追蹤判斷疏浚土的有益利用~Evaluate dredged-sediment reuse through material routing, elevation and ecological follow-up

units.anchor: 材料分流與去向~Material routing and destinations
units.title: 材料分流與去向~Material routing and destinations
units.mechanism: 有益利用先確認可用材料類別與接收目的，不能將全部挖出量直接算成成功利用。篩分、脫水和不合用材料各有去向，所有分類需用一致乾質量基準並避免重複計數；接收場適合性還有污染、鹽分與地工條件，帳面分流不能取代證據。 假設乾固體10000t中砂6500t、細料3000t、雜物500t，質量守恆10000t；若僅砂獲適用驗證，確認再利用率65%。 ~Beneficial reuse starts with material classification and receiving purpose rather than counting all excavation as successful use. Screening, dewatering and unsuitable fractions have distinct destinations that require one dry-mass basis and no duplicate counting. Suitability additionally depends on contaminants, salinity and geotechnical behavior, so an accounting split cannot substitute for evidence of fitness at the receiving site. Assume dry solids10000t comprise sand6500t,fines3000t and debris500t. Balance closes; if only sand is verified suitable, confirmed reuse is65%.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設乾固體10000t中砂6500t、細料3000t、雜物500t，質量守恆10000t；若僅砂獲適用驗證，確認再利用率65%。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume dry solids10000t comprise sand6500t,fines3000t and debris500t. Balance closes; if only sand is verified suitable, confirmed reuse is65%.
units.verify: 對每一批建立來源、檢測、處理與接收紀錄，核對三類材料是否同用乾質量。將待判定材料獨立保留，不以計畫去向當成已完成利用，並查證接收端實際數量和用途。~Trace each batch through source, testing, treatment and receipt, checking a common dry-mass basis. Keep unresolved material separate, distinguish planned destinations from completed reuse, and verify actual received quantity and purpose rather than relying only on dispatch records.
units.failure: 把含水泥漿與乾砂噸數相加會造出虛假利用量，待檢材料提前算成功也會掩蓋不合用比例。不同接收場需要的性質不同，不能以一處通過代表全用途適用。~Adding wet slurry tonnes to dry sand invents reuse quantities, and counting untested material as accepted hides unsuitable fractions. Different receiving sites need different properties; acceptance for one purpose does not qualify every other use.
units.misconception: 疏浚材料只要有預定去向就全部算成已驗證成功再利用。~Every dredged batch with a planned destination already counts as verified successful reuse.
units.practice: 對每一批建立來源、檢測、處理與接收紀錄，核對三類材料是否同用乾質量。將待判定材料獨立保留，不以計畫去向當成已完成利用，並查證接收端實際數量和用途。~Trace each batch through source, testing, treatment and receipt, checking a common dry-mass basis. Keep unresolved material separate, distinguish planned destinations from completed reuse, and verify actual received quantity and purpose rather than relying only on dispatch records.

units.anchor: 薄層放置與高程~Thin-layer placement and elevation
units.title: 薄層放置與高程~Thin-layer placement and elevation
units.mechanism: 濕地放置厚度決定表面相對潮位位置，但卸入泥漿體積尚含會排出的水。完成厚度需明確指排水後或長期壓密後的狀態，地面高程和植被耐受也有空間差異；一個平均厚度不能保證所有區域得到相同淹水時間或恢復條件。 假設排水後保留體積12000m³、面積60000m²且均勻，平均厚度t=V/A=0.20m；不含後續壓密沉陷。 ~Placement thickness sets surface position relative to tides, but delivered slurry includes water that later drains. Completed thickness must identify whether it is after drainage or longer-term consolidation. Terrain and vegetation tolerance vary spatially, so a mean layer cannot establish equal inundation or recovery conditions throughout the entire restored area without additional elevation and ecological observations. Assume retained post-drainage volume12000m³ over60000m² uniformly. Mean thickness t=V/A=0.20m, excluding subsequent consolidation settlement.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設排水後保留體積12000m³、面積60000m²且均勻，平均厚度t=V/A=0.20m；不含後續壓密沉陷。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume retained post-drainage volume12000m³ over60000m² uniformly. Mean thickness t=V/A=0.20m, excluding subsequent consolidation settlement.
units.verify: 比較放置前後同基準高程面，標明體積對應的排水時點及施工邊界。按高低地分區檢查厚度與植被狀態，保留低窪及局部堆厚資料，而不讓全區平均取代空間分布。~Compare pre- and post-placement surfaces on one datum, specifying drainage time and boundaries. Inspect thickness and vegetation by elevation zone, retaining depressions and local mounds rather than substituting a whole-site average for the distribution that controls actual inundation.
units.failure: 平均厚度符合計畫時局部深堆仍可能掩埋植株，低區又可能沒有足夠增高。泥漿排水後高程下降若未預先分辨，會讓施工方量和生態目標失去對應。~Local mounds can bury vegetation despite a matching mean thickness, while low areas remain insufficiently raised. Unrecognized lowering during slurry drainage breaks the intended link between delivered quantity and the ecological elevation objective.
units.misconception: 平均放置厚度達標就能證明每個位置的淹水條件都合適。~A satisfactory mean placement thickness proves suitable inundation at every location.
units.practice: 比較放置前後同基準高程面，標明體積對應的排水時點及施工邊界。按高低地分區檢查厚度與植被狀態，保留低窪及局部堆厚資料，而不讓全區平均取代空間分布。~Compare pre- and post-placement surfaces on one datum, specifying drainage time and boundaries. Inspect thickness and vegetation by elevation zone, retaining depressions and local mounds rather than substituting a whole-site average for the distribution that controls actual inundation.

units.anchor: 壓密後高程餘量~Post-consolidation elevation reserve
units.title: 壓密後高程餘量~Post-consolidation elevation reserve
units.mechanism: 細泥排水壓密會使放置面逐漸降低，固體體積保持時孔隙比變化可換算一維厚度縮減。真實地基也會沉陷、側向流動及有機質分解，因此這個模型只涵蓋單層材料本身；應將施工時點高程和長期目標分開，而非一次測量完成即結案。 假設初厚1m、初孔隙比e0=2、末孔隙比e1=1，末厚H1=H0(1+e1)/(1+e0)=0.667m，沉陷0.333m。 ~Fine sediment lowers as it drains and consolidates. At fixed solid volume, void-ratio change gives a one-dimensional thickness reduction. Foundation settlement, lateral spreading and organic decomposition add other mechanisms, so this model covers only the placed layer itself. Construction elevation and long-term target must remain distinct, and one completion survey cannot close the performance assessment. Assume initial thickness1m,e0=2 and final e1=1. H1=H0(1+e1)/(1+e0)=0.667m and settlement0.333m, with fixed solid volume.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設初厚1m、初孔隙比e0=2、末孔隙比e1=1，末厚H1=H0(1+e1)/(1+e0)=0.667m，沉陷0.333m。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume initial thickness1m,e0=2 and final e1=1. H1=H0(1+e1)/(1+e0)=0.667m and settlement0.333m, with fixed solid volume.
units.verify: 用沉陷板和孔壓觀測區分材料壓密與原地基移動，核對孔隙比樣本的代表性。比較不同時間的高程及乾固體存量，將側向外移和有機質損失另列，不強迫所有變化符合一維式。~Use settlement and pore-pressure observations to distinguish placed-layer consolidation from foundation movement, checking void-ratio sampling. Compare elevation and dry-solid storage through time, listing lateral export and organic loss separately instead of forcing all change into one-dimensional compression.
units.failure: 把原地基沉陷也算成填料壓密會誤估所需材料，未考慮側向流動又可能低估低處擴散。高程達標後持續下降會改變植被帶與潮溝連通，影響復育功能。~Assigning foundation settlement entirely to fill consolidation misstates material demand, while omitted spreading understates movement into low areas. Continued lowering after nominal completion alters vegetation zones and creek connectivity, changing the intended restoration function.
units.misconception: 放置材料乾固體沒有流失就代表地表高程不會再下降。~If placed dry solids are retained, surface elevation cannot subsequently decrease.
units.practice: 用沉陷板和孔壓觀測區分材料壓密與原地基移動，核對孔隙比樣本的代表性。比較不同時間的高程及乾固體存量，將側向外移和有機質損失另列，不強迫所有變化符合一維式。~Use settlement and pore-pressure observations to distinguish placed-layer consolidation from foundation movement, checking void-ratio sampling. Compare elevation and dry-solid storage through time, listing lateral export and organic loss separately instead of forcing all change into one-dimensional compression.

units.anchor: 潮汐淹水比例~Tidal inundation fraction
units.title: 潮汐淹水比例~Tidal inundation fraction
units.mechanism: 潮位與地面高程的相對關係決定浸水時間，對植被及水質交換都重要。單一正弦潮忽略不對稱、風增水與排水滯後，但能說明高程小變動如何改變淹水比例；時間比例不同於水深，也不能直接換成某物種存活率或生態成功機率。 假設潮位η=A sinωt、A=1m、地面z=0.5m且無滯水，淹水比例arccos(z/A)/π=1/3，非存活率。 ~Relative tide and ground elevation determine inundation duration, affecting vegetation and exchange. One sinusoid omits asymmetry, wind setup and drainage lag but illustrates how elevation changes alter the wet fraction. Duration fraction differs from water depth and cannot directly become a species-survival probability or a general measure of ecological success at the restoration site. Assume tideη=A sinωt,A=1m and ground z=0.5m without ponding. Inundation fraction arccos(z/A)/π=1/3, not survival probability.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設潮位η=A sinωt、A=1m、地面z=0.5m且無滯水，淹水比例arccos(z/A)/π=1/3，非存活率。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume tideη=A sinωt,A=1m and ground z=0.5m without ponding. Inundation fraction arccos(z/A)/π=1/3, not survival probability.
units.verify: 以同一高程基準記錄地面與潮位序列，實算超過地面時間並檢查退潮後積水。按季節和植被區分組比較，說明正弦示意漏掉的長週期變化與降雨，不用單次高潮代表全年。~Record terrain and tide on one datum and count exceedance time while checking post-tide ponding. Compare by season and vegetation zone, identifying long-period variation and rainfall omitted by the sinusoid rather than treating one high tide as representative of the year.
units.failure: 排水溝阻塞會使實際浸水長於海潮超越時間，基準偏差又會把植被帶放錯高程。只用平均潮差而不看長時間序列，可能漏掉持續積水的關鍵事件。~Blocked drainage prolongs inundation beyond tidal exceedance, while datum errors misplace vegetation zones. A mean tidal range without a long record can miss the sustained flooding events that govern the actual response of restored habitat.
units.misconception: 潮位超過地面的時間比例直接等於植被的存活機率。~The fraction of time tide exceeds ground directly equals plant survival probability.
units.practice: 以同一高程基準記錄地面與潮位序列，實算超過地面時間並檢查退潮後積水。按季節和植被區分組比較，說明正弦示意漏掉的長週期變化與降雨，不用單次高潮代表全年。~Record terrain and tide on one datum and count exceedance time while checking post-tide ponding. Compare by season and vegetation zone, identifying long-period variation and rainfall omitted by the sinusoid rather than treating one high tide as representative of the year.

units.anchor: 篩分回收與產率~Screening recovery and yield
units.title: 篩分回收與產率~Screening recovery and yield
units.mechanism: 分離處理需同時看產品中目標粒群的純度和原料目標粒群的回收率，兩者分母不同。增加篩分強度可能提高純度卻流失可用砂，且濕篩和乾篩結果需統一基準；工程用途還要求其他性質，因此產品比例不能被當成最終可用性證明。 假設原料乾砂600t，產品含砂540t且產品總乾質量600t；砂回收率540/600=90%，產品純度也90%，分母巧合相同。 ~Separation must distinguish product purity from recovery of the target fraction in the feed, because the denominators differ. More aggressive screening may increase purity while losing usable sand, and wet and dry results require one basis. Intended use imposes additional properties, so a high product fraction does not itself qualify the material for placement or structural performance. Assume feed contains600t dry sand; product contains540t sand in600t total dry mass. Recovery and purity are both90%, with coincidentally equal denominators.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設原料乾砂600t，產品含砂540t且產品總乾質量600t；砂回收率540/600=90%，產品純度也90%，分母巧合相同。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume feed contains600t dry sand; product contains540t sand in600t total dry mass. Recovery and purity are both90%, with coincidentally equal denominators.
units.verify: 分別採原料、產品和排除物樣本，建立目標粒群的完整乾質量平衡。用兩個不同分母重新計算回收與純度，檢查細料附著和含水偏差，並記錄未被篩分指標代表的材料需求。~Sample feed, product and reject streams and close the target fraction’s dry-mass balance. Recalculate recovery and purity using their distinct denominators, checking attached fines and moisture bias, and list material requirements that screening metrics alone do not represent.
units.failure: 把產品純度當回收率可能隱藏大量好砂被丟棄，反之回收率高也可能得到含細料過多的產品。只有單一產品樣本，不能追查分離設備真正的物料去向。~Substituting purity for recovery can conceal discarded good sand, while high recovery may produce an excessively fine-rich product. A product-only sample cannot reveal the actual routing of material through the separation process.
units.misconception: 產品純度與原料回收率永遠具有相同分母而且相等。~Product purity and feed recovery always share the same denominator and value.
units.practice: 分別採原料、產品和排除物樣本，建立目標粒群的完整乾質量平衡。用兩個不同分母重新計算回收與純度，檢查細料附著和含水偏差，並記錄未被篩分指標代表的材料需求。~Sample feed, product and reject streams and close the target fraction’s dry-mass balance. Recalculate recovery and purity using their distinct denominators, checking attached fines and moisture bias, and list material requirements that screening metrics alone do not represent.

units.anchor: 污染質量與濃度~Contaminant mass versus concentration
units.title: 污染質量與濃度~Contaminant mass versus concentration
units.mechanism: 固體污染物濃度乘乾質量可得到總負荷，這與孔隙水溶出或生物可利用性不同。混合會改變平均濃度卻不讓污染物消失，因此守恆算例絕不能被當成稀釋達標方法；評估須依物質、暴露路徑和適用法域選用檢測，不能只憑平均數決定用途。 假設乾料1000t、某示蹤物20mg/kg，總量20kg；加入1000t不含該物材料後均濃度10mg/kg，但總量仍20kg。 ~Dry-basis concentration times sediment mass gives total burden, distinct from dissolved release or bioavailability. Mixing changes mean concentration without destroying contaminants, so this conservation example must never be treated as a dilution-to-compliance method. Evaluation requires substance-specific tests, exposure pathways and applicable jurisdiction, not a use decision based solely on a convenient bulk average. Assume1000t dry sediment at tracer concentration20mg/kg: total20kg. Adding1000t tracer-free material gives10mg/kg while total remains20kg; no compliance claim.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設乾料1000t、某示蹤物20mg/kg，總量20kg；加入1000t不含該物材料後均濃度10mg/kg，但總量仍20kg。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume1000t dry sediment at tracer concentration20mg/kg: total20kg. Adding1000t tracer-free material gives10mg/kg while total remains20kg; no compliance claim.
units.verify: 保留乾基定義、採樣分區與分析品質資料，分別計算總質量與濃度。另查溶出、生物暴露及材料用途的必要試驗，將任何混合方案交由適用程序評估，不把降低平均值當成去除污染。~Retain dry-basis definition, sampling zones and analytical quality records, calculating burden separately from concentration. Evaluate required leaching, biological exposure and intended-use tests through the applicable process, without treating a lower mixed average as removal of the substance.
units.failure: 熱點被大量低濃度樣本平均後可能消失在報表中，總負荷和局部接觸仍存在。以稀釋比例代替處理成效會漏掉溶出條件改變和生物累積的可能途徑。~A hotspot can disappear statistically among low-concentration samples while burden and local exposure persist. Replacing treatment evidence with a dilution ratio overlooks changes in leaching conditions and possible pathways for biological accumulation after placement.
units.misconception: 混合後平均濃度降低代表同百分比的污染物已被消除。~A lower average concentration after mixing means the same fraction of contaminant was destroyed.
units.practice: 保留乾基定義、採樣分區與分析品質資料，分別計算總質量與濃度。另查溶出、生物暴露及材料用途的必要試驗，將任何混合方案交由適用程序評估，不把降低平均值當成去除污染。~Retain dry-basis definition, sampling zones and analytical quality records, calculating burden separately from concentration. Evaluate required leaching, biological exposure and intended-use tests through the applicable process, without treating a lower mixed average as removal of the substance.

units.anchor: 覆蓋厚度與侵蝕餘量~Cover thickness and erosion reserve
units.title: 覆蓋厚度與侵蝕餘量~Cover thickness and erosion reserve
units.mechanism: 隔離覆蓋層需維持連續厚度，平均放置量不能代表局部最薄處。侵蝕、壓密和底泥混入會消耗幾何餘量，而化學隔離還涉及擴散與生物擾動；本課只計厚度收支，不提供任何污染場址的建議覆蓋規格或長期隔離保證。 假設初始覆蓋0.50m、侵蝕0.08m、壓密0.04m且均勻，剩餘0.38m；未考慮混層、擴散與生物擾動。 ~A cover layer needs continuous thickness, and average placed quantity does not describe its thinnest location. Erosion, consolidation and mixing consume geometric reserve, while chemical isolation also involves diffusion and biological disturbance. This lesson only accounts for thickness; it supplies no recommended contaminated-site cap specification and cannot establish durable isolation from the remaining number alone. Assume initial cover0.50m,erosion0.08m and compression0.04m uniformly. Remaining thickness is0.38m, excluding mixing, diffusion and bioturbation.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設初始覆蓋0.50m、侵蝕0.08m、壓密0.04m且均勻，剩餘0.38m；未考慮混層、擴散與生物擾動。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume initial cover0.50m,erosion0.08m and compression0.04m uniformly. Remaining thickness is0.38m, excluding mixing, diffusion and bioturbation.
units.verify: 用可辨識界面量測覆蓋層頂底，分區記錄最薄值和不確定度，核對侵蝕與壓密是否重複扣除。另查材料相容、滲流和生物作用，不讓幾何驗證取代完整隔離績效評估。~Measure identifiable upper and lower interfaces, recording minimum thickness and uncertainty by zone and checking double-counted erosion or compression. Assess compatibility, seepage and biological processes separately so geometric verification does not replace a complete isolation-performance evaluation.
units.failure: 覆蓋料與原泥混合會使外觀厚度足夠但隔離距離不足，局部沖槽也可能穿透平均合格的區域。只依材料總方量驗收，無法找到控制暴露的薄弱路徑。~Mixing with native sediment can leave adequate apparent thickness but inadequate separation, while a local scour channel breaches an otherwise satisfactory average cover. Total material quantity cannot identify the thin pathways controlling actual exposure.
units.misconception: 覆蓋材料總方量足夠就能證明各處隔離厚度與化學功能足夠。~Enough total cover volume proves adequate thickness and chemical isolation everywhere.
units.practice: 用可辨識界面量測覆蓋層頂底，分區記錄最薄值和不確定度，核對侵蝕與壓密是否重複扣除。另查材料相容、滲流和生物作用，不讓幾何驗證取代完整隔離績效評估。~Measure identifiable upper and lower interfaces, recording minimum thickness and uncertainty by zone and checking double-counted erosion or compression. Assess compatibility, seepage and biological processes separately so geometric verification does not replace a complete isolation-performance evaluation.

units.anchor: 填料有效應力~Effective stress in placed sediment
units.title: 填料有效應力~Effective stress in placed sediment
units.mechanism: 新放置細泥的自重部分由孔隙水承受，有效應力才與土骨架壓縮及強度形成相關。總應力增加不等於立即取得同樣骨架荷載，排水時間和地層連通性需要量測；一個有效應力數值也不能直接代替剪力強度或允許設備通行荷重。 假設某點總垂直應力50kPa、孔隙壓35kPa，有效應力σ′=σ−u=15kPa；若總應力不變而u降10kPa，σ′升至25kPa。 ~Pore water supports part of freshly placed sediment weight; effective stress governs skeleton loading, compression and strength development. Increased total stress does not immediately become equal skeleton load, and drainage timing and connectivity need observation. One effective-stress result cannot replace a shear-strength evaluation or establish allowable equipment loading on a soft placement surface in the field. Assume total vertical stress50kPa and pore pressure35kPa:σ′=15kPa. At fixed total stress, a10kPa pressure fall raisesσ′ to25kPa.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設某點總垂直應力50kPa、孔隙壓35kPa，有效應力σ′=σ−u=15kPa；若總應力不變而u降10kPa，σ′升至25kPa。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume total vertical stress50kPa and pore pressure35kPa:σ′=15kPa. At fixed total stress, a10kPa pressure fall raisesσ′ to25kPa.
units.verify: 在同一高程與時刻比較孔壓和總荷載，檢查加載、潮位與排水的共同影響。以獨立土樣或現地試驗追蹤強度演進，明列有效應力與承載判斷之間仍缺的材料關係。~Compare pore pressure and total loading at matching elevations and times, checking loading, tide and drainage together. Track strength with independent samples or field tests and state the constitutive relationships still needed between effective stress and a bearing assessment.
units.failure: 孔壓計零點漂移可能假造排水進展，忽略新增填土則錯判有效應力變化。表面看似乾燥而深部仍高孔壓時，設備荷載可能造成局部變形或側向擠出。~Piezometer drift can mimic drainage, while omitted new fill misstates effective-stress change. A dry-looking surface over persistently high deep pore pressures can still deform locally or squeeze laterally under equipment loading.
units.misconception: 表面變乾就代表全部填料已完全排水並取得最終強度。~A dry surface proves that the entire fill has drained and reached final strength.
units.practice: 在同一高程與時刻比較孔壓和總荷載，檢查加載、潮位與排水的共同影響。以獨立土樣或現地試驗追蹤強度演進，明列有效應力與承載判斷之間仍缺的材料關係。~Compare pore pressure and total loading at matching elevations and times, checking loading, tide and drainage together. Track strength with independent samples or field tests and state the constitutive relationships still needed between effective stress and a bearing assessment.

units.anchor: 運輸碳量比較~Transport emissions comparison
units.title: 運輸碳量比較~Transport emissions comparison
units.mechanism: 有益利用可改變材料運距與新料需求，但環境比較必須採相同功能和系統邊界。運輸噸公里只是部分排放，處理、泵送、空車回程及未避免的新料也可能重要；合成係數只練習計量，不能把局部節省包裝成完整生命週期淨收益。 假設10000t材料運距由50降至20km、係數0.08kgCO₂e/(t·km)，運輸差額10000×30×0.08=24000kgCO₂e。 ~Reuse changes transport distance and demand for virgin material, but environmental comparisons require equivalent function and system boundaries. Tonne-kilometres describe only part of emissions; treatment, pumping, empty return trips and any unavoided supply also matter. A synthetic factor illustrates accounting rather than establishing complete life-cycle savings from a limited change in transport distance alone. Assume10000t moves20km instead of50km at0.08kgCO₂e/(t·km). Transport difference is24000kgCO₂e, excluding treatment and return-trip changes.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設10000t材料運距由50降至20km、係數0.08kgCO₂e/(t·km)，運輸差額10000×30×0.08=24000kgCO₂e。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume10000t moves20km instead of50km at0.08kgCO₂e/(t·km). Transport difference is24000kgCO₂e, excluding treatment and return-trip changes.
units.verify: 明列兩方案是否提供同樣材料功能與時間需求，記錄噸位、路程和排放係數來源。將處理、能耗和回程另列，對主要係數作敏感度比較，保留沒有證據可抵扣的項目。~State whether alternatives deliver equivalent function and timing and document mass, distance and emission-factor provenance. List treatment, energy and return trips separately, test important factors for sensitivity, and retain items without evidence for any claimed avoided burden.
units.failure: 若再利用料需要額外長時間脫水，運輸減碳可能被處理能耗抵銷。把並未真正減少的新料生產扣除，或忽略空船回程，都會放大報表上的環境好處。~Extended dewatering may offset transport savings through treatment energy. Crediting virgin production that was not actually avoided, or ignoring an empty return voyage, further inflates the environmental benefit claimed for the reuse alternative.
units.misconception: 運距縮短的排放差額就是再利用方案完整的生命週期淨減碳。~The emissions saved by shorter transport equal the reuse project's complete life-cycle benefit.
units.practice: 明列兩方案是否提供同樣材料功能與時間需求，記錄噸位、路程和排放係數來源。將處理、能耗和回程另列，對主要係數作敏感度比較，保留沒有證據可抵扣的項目。~State whether alternatives deliver equivalent function and timing and document mass, distance and emission-factor provenance. List treatment, energy and return trips separately, test important factors for sensitivity, and retain items without evidence for any claimed avoided burden.

units.anchor: 對照監測與歸因~Control monitoring and attribution
units.title: 對照監測與歸因~Control monitoring and attribution
units.mechanism: 放置後植被或生物數量改變可能同時受季節、氣候與其他工程影響，單一前後差不能直接歸因。處理區與參照區的變化差提供較好的辨識起點，但仍依賴可比性和共同趨勢；多期及重複樣區可檢查這些假設，而不是以漂亮百分比宣布復育成功。 假設處理區植被覆蓋30%升50%、參照區40%升50%，差中差=(50−30)−(50−40)=10百分點；不是因果已證實。 ~Post-placement ecological change can reflect season, climate or other works, so a simple before-after difference does not establish causation. Comparing changes in treatment and reference areas provides a stronger starting point but still requires comparability and parallel trends. Repeated periods and plots test those assumptions rather than allowing an attractive percentage to establish restoration success by itself. Assume treatment cover rises30%to50% and reference40%to50%. Difference-in-differences is10percentage points, not established causation without supporting assumptions.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設處理區植被覆蓋30%升50%、參照區40%升50%，差中差=(50−30)−(50−40)=10百分點；不是因果已證實。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume treatment cover rises30%to50% and reference40%to50%. Difference-in-differences is10percentage points, not established causation without supporting assumptions.
units.verify: 保留相同季節與方法的重複樣區，檢查施工前處理與參照區是否有近似趨勢。分開報告百分點、相對增幅及不確定度，追蹤物種組成與高程，避免只選有利單一指標。~Maintain repeated plots surveyed with the same seasonal method and examine pre-treatment trends in both areas. Report percentage points, relative changes and uncertainty separately, tracking composition and elevation rather than selecting only a favorable single indicator.
units.failure: 參照區若同時受到放置濁羽影響便不是獨立比較，前後季節不同也會造成假改善。總覆蓋增加可能來自非目標物種，不能自動解釋為恢復預期棲地。~A reference affected by the placement plume is not an independent comparison, and different survey seasons create apparent improvement. Greater total cover may arise from nontarget species rather than recovery of the intended habitat function.
units.misconception: 處理區施工後植被增加就足以證明增長完全由工程造成。~Any vegetation increase after treatment proves that the project caused the entire increase.
units.practice: 保留相同季節與方法的重複樣區，檢查施工前處理與參照區是否有近似趨勢。分開報告百分點、相對增幅及不確定度，追蹤物種組成與高程，避免只選有利單一指標。~Maintain repeated plots surveyed with the same seasonal method and examine pre-treatment trends in both areas. Report percentage points, relative changes and uncertainty separately, tracking composition and elevation rather than selecting only a favorable single indicator.

title: 疏浚泥沙有益利用~Beneficial reuse of dredged sediment
summary: 用材料分流地形高程和生態追蹤判斷疏浚土的有益利用。課程從邊界辨識與資料整理走到水理量化、構造介面及驗證紀錄；每一步把計算結果連回可量測的證據。十個不同單元分別處理關鍵機制，不以名義尺寸或單一通過率代替整體工程判斷，並明列合成算例與現地資料的差別。~Evaluate dredged-sediment reuse through material routing, elevation and ecological follow-up. The course moves from boundary identification and evidence to hydraulic quantification, structural interfaces and verification records. Ten distinct units connect each calculated quantity to measurable evidence. Nominal geometry or a single pass rate does not establish whole-system performance, and synthetic teaching examples remain separate from field observations.
history: 將疏浚物視為資源並不表示省略品質與場址評估。官方資料記錄波普勒島於一九九八年開始圍堤施工，二〇〇七年取得擴建授權，展現航道材料與島嶼棲地目標相互結合的長期工作。美國環保署與工兵團一九九八年試驗手冊提供物理、化學及生物評估背景；二〇一五年疏浚管理手冊則整合材料去向觀念。末底改島二〇一五年放置後仍持續觀測地形與生物，提醒完成施工不等於效果永久不變。本課所有比例、厚度和排放係數是原創情境，不將特定案例結果複製為普遍承諾。~Treating dredged material as a resource does not remove quality or site evaluation. Official accounts record Poplar Island containment construction beginning in1998 and expansion authorization in2007, linking navigation material with long-term habitat objectives. The1998 EPA-USACE testing manual supplies physical, chemical and biological evaluation context, while the2015 dredging manual integrates material destinations. Following2015 placement at Mordecai Island, morphology and ecological monitoring continued, demonstrating why construction completion is not permanent performance. Every fraction, thickness and emissions factor here is an original synthetic scenario, not a universal promise drawn from a single project.
example: 以下為原創合成算例，不是地標工程的實測或推薦操作值。教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設乾固體10000t中砂6500t、細料3000t、雜物500t，質量守恆10000t；若僅砂獲適用驗證，確認再利用率65%。假設其他類別保持不變，已驗證砂量6500增10%至7150t，總料由10000增至10650t，確認利用率為67.14%，並非原65%加10百分點。重新計算前先列固定條件、單位、適用尺度及可能失效的邊界。把模型敏感度與測量誤差分開，不能將單一參數變化直接當成工程風險或壽命比例。比較兩次結果後，記錄還需要哪些獨立證據，並由負責專業人員判斷適用性。~This original synthetic example is neither a landmark measurement nor a recommended operating value. Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume dry solids10000t comprise sand6500t,fines3000t and debris500t. Balance closes; if only sand is verified suitable, confirmed reuse is65%. If verified sand increases10% from6500 to7150t while other classes remain fixed, total feed becomes10650t and confirmed reuse is67.14%, not65% plus ten percentage points. Before recalculating, list fixed conditions, units, applicable scale and boundaries that could fail. Separate model sensitivity from measurement uncertainty: a parameter change does not directly give a proportional change in engineering risk or service life. Compare the results, record independent evidence still needed, and have the responsible specialist determine applicability.
facts: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設乾固體10000t中砂6500t、細料3000t、雜物500t，質量守恆10000t；若僅砂獲適用驗證，確認再利用率65%。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume dry solids10000t comprise sand6500t,fines3000t and debris500t. Balance closes; if only sand is verified suitable, confirmed reuse is65%.

教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設排水後保留體積12000m³、面積60000m²且均勻，平均厚度t=V/A=0.20m；不含後續壓密沉陷。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume retained post-drainage volume12000m³ over60000m² uniformly. Mean thickness t=V/A=0.20m, excluding subsequent consolidation settlement.

教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設初厚1m、初孔隙比e0=2、末孔隙比e1=1，末厚H1=H0(1+e1)/(1+e0)=0.667m，沉陷0.333m。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume initial thickness1m,e0=2 and final e1=1. H1=H0(1+e1)/(1+e0)=0.667m and settlement0.333m, with fixed solid volume.

教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設潮位η=A sinωt、A=1m、地面z=0.5m且無滯水，淹水比例arccos(z/A)/π=1/3，非存活率。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume tideη=A sinωt,A=1m and ground z=0.5m without ponding. Inundation fraction arccos(z/A)/π=1/3, not survival probability.

教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設原料乾砂600t，產品含砂540t且產品總乾質量600t；砂回收率540/600=90%，產品純度也90%，分母巧合相同。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume feed contains600t dry sand; product contains540t sand in600t total dry mass. Recovery and purity are both90%, with coincidentally equal denominators.

教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設乾料1000t、某示蹤物20mg/kg，總量20kg；加入1000t不含該物材料後均濃度10mg/kg，但總量仍20kg。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume1000t dry sediment at tracer concentration20mg/kg: total20kg. Adding1000t tracer-free material gives10mg/kg while total remains20kg; no compliance claim.
